hdcastle.name: Heidelberg Castle
hdcastle.slogan: Red sandstone ruin watching over the Neckar and the old town.
hdcastle.line: A ruin must be rightly situated, to be effective. This one could not have been better placed.

hdbridge.name: Old Bridge
hdbridge.slogan: Twin towers, sandstone arches and a monkey with a mirror.
hdbridge.line: Completed in 1788 by Elector Charles Theodore, this 200-metre sandstone bridge is the ninth built on the same spot.

speyerdom.name: Speyer Cathedral
speyerdom.slogan: A thousand years of emperors sleeping under one Romanesque roof.
speyerdom.line: Begun in 1030, it holds the largest Romanesque columned crypt in Europe and the graves of eight German kings and emperors.

schloss.name: Mannheim Palace
schloss.slogan: A 450-metre Baroque facade that now hosts lectures.
schloss.line: Begun in 1720 with a budget of 300,000 Gulden, it ended up costing about 2 million; today it is home to the University of Mannheim.

wasserturm.name: Wasserturm
wasserturm.slogan: Mannheim's 60-metre water tower, crowned by a copper Amphitrite.
wasserturm.line: Gustav Halmhuber won the 1885 design competition for it at age 23, beating 74 other architects.
